name: TesBots: Rollout Watch
tagline: Pings you when a Tesla software or FSD release reaches cars like yours.
description: A scheduled watch for Tesla software and FSD (Supervised) rollouts from the independent TesBots collection. It learns which car you drive, checks on a schedule, and messages you when a matching build starts landing, so the release finds you instead of you trawling owner forums.
author: TimDOES
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
